# Don & Patti Nichols — donandpatti.com

> The online home of Don & Patti Nichols: their life together, family, Christian faith, and ministry at home and abroad. Explore family recollections, free medical mission clinics in Belize, mission work in Malawi, Mozambique, Zambia and the Dominican Republic, a photograph archive, an open ledger of giving, and itemized mission-trip costs published by Don himself.

The blog contains posts by Don and Patti Nichols. The Life & Ministry collection contains edited recollections shared by Don and their son Ryan, with the storyteller and recording date identified on each article. A recollection's recording date is distinct from its publication date. Mission resources draw on Don and Patti's records, and budget figures are the prices Don records for the mission.

## Current campaign

- [A water well and a maize mill for a village in Malawi](https://www.donandpatti.com/malawi-water-well): Don Nichols is raising $7,630 (his figure, converted from the Kwacha bid) for a bore hole in a Malawi village still drinking muddy water, and a maize mill whose grinding fees sponsor a soccer team that shares the Gospel at halftime. Gifts are forwarded to Wings of Promise, Inc. (995 S. Lakeside, Vidor, TX 77662); Skipper Sauls of Maplecrest Baptist Church oversees the funds and the project. Don's own posts: [Bore Hole or Maize Mill in Malawi](https://www.donandpatti.com/blog/bore-hole-or-1b520dc8), [Water Well Request](https://www.donandpatti.com/blog/water-well-request-a3986b64), [Maize Mill Request](https://www.donandpatti.com/blog/maize-mill-request-6f42d0fc).

## Life & Ministry

These articles retell family recollections recorded in August 2026 and published September 12, 2026. They do not date the remembered events to 2026.

- [The Family They Chose to Build](https://www.donandpatti.com/our-story/the-family-they-chose-to-build): Ryan's recollection of his parents putting family first.
- [The Faith Patti Passed On](https://www.donandpatti.com/our-story/the-faith-patti-passed-on): Ryan remembers his mother's example of faith.
- [Ministry at Home](https://www.donandpatti.com/our-story/ministry-at-home): Ryan remembers his parents caring for family and community.
- [The Ordination Question Don Never Forgot](https://www.donandpatti.com/our-story/the-ordination-question-don-never-forgot): Don recalls his priorities as a husband, father, and preacher.
- [The Night the Fishing Boat Wouldn't Start](https://www.donandpatti.com/our-story/the-night-the-fishing-boat-wouldnt-start): Don recalls a night fishing with his father on Lake Fork.
- [Fishing, Faith, and the Nichols Family](https://www.donandpatti.com/our-story/fishing-faith-and-the-nichols-family): Don describes a family fishing book he was preparing; publication is not claimed.
- [My Dad Was Always My Superhero](https://www.donandpatti.com/our-story/my-dad-was-always-my-superhero): Ryan remembers Don's influence on his desire to serve in the Marines.
- [The Conversations Behind Don's Daniel Notes](https://www.donandpatti.com/our-story/the-conversations-behind-dons-daniel-notes): Don explains the classroom context for his saved teaching notes, rather than publishing the lessons themselves.

## By the numbers

Data articles published September 12, 2026. Every chart derives from the budget and trip timeline Don Nichols publishes on this site; nothing is estimated or borrowed from another organisation.

- [Where does a mission trip donation actually go?](https://www.donandpatti.com/articles/where-does-a-mission-donation-go): Don's supply-drive budget charted line by line, supplies versus logistics.
- [What $25 buys on a medical mission trip](https://www.donandpatti.com/articles/what-25-dollars-buys-on-a-mission-trip): reading glasses, Bibles, hygiene kits at real prices, with a trunk you can pack yourself.
- [Thirteen years of mission trips, in charts](https://www.donandpatti.com/articles/mission-trip-timeline-in-charts): trips per year and per country since 2013, including the years with none.
- [The math of monthly giving](https://www.donandpatti.com/articles/monthly-giving-math): what a monthly gift becomes in a year, with a slider.
- [Quiz: how much do you know about medical missions?](https://www.donandpatti.com/articles/medical-missions-quiz): ten questions, every answer sourced to a page on this site.
- [The 90-day mission trip checklist](https://www.donandpatti.com/articles/mission-trip-planning-checklist): tick it off in the browser and print it.
- [Mission trip fundraising ideas](https://www.donandpatti.com/articles/mission-trip-fundraising-ideas): seven ideas and a goal calculator.
- [Belize by the numbers](https://www.donandpatti.com/articles/belize-by-the-numbers): the Belize Don describes, in his words and figures.
